cost.relative_to_B1_16_5s: approximately +29% mean rerank time; peak CUDA allocation remains about 16.6 GiB

implementation_note: Direct run is authoritative. Offline remapping of frozen 5-second Top-3 predictions to 8 seconds is not used for the gate because 8-second non-overlap selection changes the candidate set.
gate_decision: G4 not passed; retain as Phase 4 candidate
reason: B1C improves ordinary pilot and clean97 overall metrics and partially improves confirmed boundary/short-event coverage, but it does not improve the historical heldout aggregate, loses 2/10 final controls at Top-k IoU>=0.5, and costs about 29% more. Keep B1 16-frame/5-second as default until a stronger quality-latency policy is validated.
